target_customer: AI agent builders, sales, recruiting and investment platforms that need live B2B people and company data
problem: Sales and recruiting AI products need fresh people and company data, but static datasets go stale and scraping is hard to maintain.

founders.name: Abhilash Chowdhary
previous_startups: Robotwits (acquired by Waymo, per YC page)

founders.name: Manmohit Grewal
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built and sold data products for D2C enablers and POS companies

founders.name: Chris Pisarski
founders.background_notes: Head of Product and Head of Sales roles per YC page

technical_complexity.rationale: Ingesting live data from a dozen sources and serving it fast is standard data engineering with hard scraping and entity resolution parts.

defensibility.rationale: Data coverage and freshness help, but scraping based data providers are easy to replicate and exposed to platform legal risk.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not shown in sources; Proxycurl shut down in January 2025 after a LinkedIn lawsuit per Crustdata's own blog, which opened room for Crustdata.

market_need_then: AI SDR, recruiting and diligence products were multiplying in 2024 and needed live people and company data; specific dated demand evidence was not opened.

identity.visual_style: Developer focused site with docs, sandbox and case studies
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, benefit driven, short punchy headlines

brand_strength.rationale: Brand is plain and developer oriented; no press on the brand itself and no naming story found.

outcome_analysis: Crustdata joined YC in Fall 2024 as a real-time B2B data API for AI agents and announced a 6 million dollar seed in October 2025. By its own account revenue grew from 770 thousand to over 4 million dollars in seven months with a one person sales team and profitability. The growth claims are company reported and legal risk around scraped data remains.
notes: Seed amount cross-checked by Pulse2 and Preqin snippets in search results (not opened). An earlier 2024 seed of about 500K appears only on aggregators and is unverified. Founding year conflicts across sources (2020 to 2024), left null. Revenue figures are company reported. Competitor search returned only Crustdata's own comparison pages from 2025, so no dated competitor list is recorded. Outcome search found nothing about Crustdata.
